records.title: Tunalı ve Kuğulu Park hattı
records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one landscape 1536×1024 high-resolution photographic editorial image, part of GEZEK / Ankara 101 C2 collection of twelve. Generate ONLY the image, no grid, contact sheet, mockup, border or typography.
Art direction: premium independent contemporary city magazine, quiet and observant rather than tourism advertising. Believable Central Anatolian Ankara materials and early-autumn air. Natural soft side daylight, restrained warm-neutral grading, muted mineral/olive/ivory midtones, gentle navy shadows with detail, subtle analogue film grain, tactile real-world texture. Human-eye camera 35–50mm equivalent, calm intentional asymmetry, optically credible perspective, not HDR or oversharpened; no orange-teal grade or generic dramatic sunset.
Factual boundary: an imagined editorial interpretation informed by the region's materials and spatial character, NOT a documentary photo or exact reconstruction of the named real place. Do not copy any reference photograph or exact architectural layout. No precise historical detail, invented inscription, real artefact replica, emblem or identifiable painting/sculpture.
No readable text, signs, plaques, shop names, logos, watermarks or baked-in vector graphics. No fantasy skyline. No close recognizable faces, duplicated people, malformed limbs, bent walls or impossible structures. Keep the main semantic subject in the central crop-safe region; purposeful detail should survive Hero, square and compact crops. Long text will be placed outside the image.
Scene: contemporary Ankara park-to-street transition at pedestrian eye level: mature trees and a small quiet park edge in foreground open toward a modest urban pavement and an unlabelled passage/side-street with restrained midrise city fabric beyond. Two small non-identifiable adults walking in different directions at natural distance; correct anatomy. Everyday city movement, leaf shadows, park/city threshold, not a coffee still-life or generic retail postcard. No named business, readable storefronts, invented exact facade, exaggerated skyline or close faces. Early-autumn soft afternoon light, muted sage and warm plaster with restrained contemporary navy detail. Focal point x=.48 y=.54 on the pedestrian transition.
records.intended_editorial_meaning: Olgun ağaçlar, park-cadde eşiği ve gündelik yaya ritmi
records.factual_reference_notes: References informed materials, landscape and atmosphere; no photograph copied or traced. Final scene is an imagined editorial interpretation, not a verified spatial reconstruction.
records.prohibited_documentary_claim: Do not label this as a photograph, exact view or historical evidence of the named real place. No exact artefact/inscription identification.
records.safe_region_definition: Intersection of the three declared mechanical crops, not a guarantee for arbitrary aspect ratios. Re-review new ratios.
